description: The full source of a non-deck artifact — a flyer, page, t-shirt or brochure — in its kind's Lore grammar, ready to inspect or hand back after a change. For a flyer that is `kind: flyer` frontmatter plus its `== face` blocks. Use language_reference(kind) for the grammar. An opaque or future kind is returned as its stored JSON rather than a guessed grammar.
name: read_artifact
title: Read an artifact as source
